typography.headings: Teko, uppercase, tight tracking, massive sizes (text-5xl to text-8xl). Must feel heavy and athletic.
typography.body: Chakra Petch, technical and legible. Uppercase with wide tracking for labels.

colors.primary_description: Electric Blaze - High Energy Orange/Red. Used for primary CTAs and active states.
colors.success_description: Volt Green - Used for PRs, completed workouts, and positive feedback.

visual_enhancers.depth: No soft shadows. Use 1px inner borders (box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05)) or subtle luminance shifts.
visual_enhancers.glow: Tight, high-intensity glows around primary actions only (shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(255,69,0,0.15)]).
visual_enhancers.borders: Tracing beam borders for active components using CSS animations.
visual_enhancers.corners: Remove old cyberpunk clip-corners. Use sharp or 4px radius (rounded-md) for an athletic/tactical feel.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Avoid generic SaaS gradients. Use stark contrasts or deep dark gradients (e.g., #121214 to #0A0A0B).

layouts.grid: Bento Box Mode B (High Density). 12-column grid for dashboards and dense data.
layouts.spacing: Generous paddings (p-6, p-8) inside cards to allow content to breathe despite dense grids.
layouts.mobile_first: Scale down gracefully. Stack columns on mobile (grid-cols-1).
layouts.alignment: Left-align dense content and data. Center-align hero typography only when mathematically balanced.

components.af-card: bg-[#0A0A0B] border border-white/10 rounded-md transition-all duration-200 hover:border-[#FF4500]/40
components.btn-primary: bg-[#FF4500] text-black font-teko uppercase tracking-wider font-bold px-6 py-3 rounded-md hover:bg-[#FF5A1F] transition-all flex items-center justify-center min-h-[48px]
components.btn-outline: bg-transparent border border-white/10 text-white font-teko uppercase px-6 py-3 rounded-md hover:border-[#FF4500] hover:text-[#FF4500] transition-all min-h-[48px]
components.input: bg-[#121214] border border-white/10 text-white font-chakra rounded-md p-3 w-full min-h-[48px] focus:border-[#FF4500] outline-none transition-colors
components.badges: Sharp rectangular or subtle rounded badges. Primary bg with 10% opacity, solid 1px border, text primary color.

motion.hover: Slight upward translation (-translate-y-1) and border color shift.
motion.glow_pulse: Pulse opacity/scale of glow behind active elements. Use `animate-pulse` or custom keyframes.
motion.transitions: Use `transition-all duration-200 ease-out` for interactive elements.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA standards. Muted text must still be readable (#A1A1AA on #050505).
accessibility.focus: Clear focus states on inputs and buttons (e.g., focus:border-[#FF4500] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#FF4500]).
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (kebab-case).

signature_moments.name: Level-up / Milestone Celebration
signature_moments.description: Screen shake effect, massive text counter rolling up, particle explosion in Electric Blaze (#FF4500).

signature_moments.name: Workout Completion
signature_moments.description: Full screen dark overlay. Stats stamped onto the screen one by one with heavy impact scale animations (like a physical stamp).

signature_moments.name: PR Unlock
signature_moments.description: Volt Green (#39FF14) tracing beam circles the stat card rapidly, followed by a bright flash and text expanding.

signature_moments.name: Rest-Timer Sequence
signature_moments.description: Massive circular progress in the center of the screen with a breathing animation (expands/contracts slowly) to pace the user's rest.

screen_blueprints.Login: Dark, moody minimalist. Giant alpha flame logo pulsing. Standard Shadcn inputs styled dark. Electric Blaze CTA full width.
screen_blueprints.Onboarding: Step-by-step wizard. Massive typography for questions (text-4xl+). Grid of selectable cards for goals/equipment. Progress bar fixed at top.
screen_blueprints.Dashboard: Bento Grid Mode B. Left/Main col: Active session hero (tracing border), Week Schedule. Right/Sidebar col: Stats bento, Quick actions.
screen_blueprints.Active Workout: Data-heavy tactical HUD. Huge reps/weight inputs (Chakra Petch). Rest timer overlay. Swipeable/Carousel for exercise image generation.
screen_blueprints.Plan View: List of days in distinct blocks. Expandable exercise lists. Use subtle drag-and-drop handles on the left. High contrast headers.
screen_blueprints.Progress: Recharts line charts with Electric Blaze stroke. Muscle-group heatmap SVG colored with #FF4500 intensity map. Badges collection grid.
screen_blueprints.Nutrition: Macro progress rings. Camera interface for scanning with corner-reticle framing. Clean list of logged meals with macro breakdown.
screen_blueprints.Body Scan: Camera overlay with AI scanning lines (CSS scanline vertical sweep). Split screen for results: photo left, AI recommendation cards right.
screen_blueprints.Social: Leaderboards with Gold/Silver/Bronze text accents for top 3. Avatar placeholders or initials in sharp bordered circles.
screen_blueprints.Settings: Minimalist list layout. Toggles in Electric Blaze. High contrast destructive buttons for account deletion.
screen_blueprints.Admin Dashboard: Dense data table. Use Shadcn tables with dark theme, tight padding, and hover row highlights.
screen_blueprints.Coach Chat: Chat interface. AI bubbles dark with primary 1px border. User bubbles dark gray. Async polling loader with tactical typing dots.

instructions_to_main_agent: Read this guideline entirely before modifying files.
The Dashboard.jsx and index.css have already been updated as the flagship implementation. Use them as reference.
Apply these design tokens and layouts to all remaining 11 pages.
Replace old `.af-card` clip-corners and cyan glows with the new `rounded-md` tactical bento box style and Electric Blaze accents.
Remove old neon cyan (#00BFFF) references in code and replace with Electric Blaze or CSS variables.
Use Shadcn UI components where possible but strip their default styling to match this dark tactical aesthetic.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Always use dark mode. Never apply universal transition (`transition: all` without specific properties if transforms are involved, though `transition-all` in tailwind is fine). Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and subtle borders. Use glass-morphism effects carefully with very low opacity and heavy blur. Do not use generic centered layouts for data. Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus states). No purple/violet gradients. No transparent backgrounds over scrolling content.
